description: A college director of library services must authorize an eight-week extended-hours library pilot and finalize its operating schedule, staffing, access controls, and funding, with input from facilities, campus safety, information technology, and finance.

shared_context.S1: The college is considering an eight-week pilot that would keep the main library open later during the evening.
shared_context.S2: The current proposal lists Monday through Friday operation from 10:00 p.m. until midnight, with one library employee and ordinary student-ID access.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Lena Morris has authority to approve the pilot and sign its operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The college's routine pre-authorization process requires facilities, campus safety, library IT, and finance to review the operating plan before the director signs it.

PF1.text: A fire-alarm panel test has been scheduled in the main library every Wednesday evening during the pilot period, and Facilities has confirmed that the building cannot be occupied during the test; Jamal Reed received the work order this week but has not amended the library proposal.

PF2.text: Campus safety policy requires at least two authorized adults in the building whenever the library remains open after 10:00 p.m.; Captain Elena Ruiz confirmed the policy with the evening patrol supervisor this week but has not added it to the operating plan.

PF3.text: The library's access-control system can support the pilot only if entry is limited to currently enrolled students using college ID cards; unrestricted access for all standard ID holders would leave expired and visitor credentials active after 10:00 p.m., and Priya Nair identified this configuration issue during a system check but has not reported it to the director.

PF4.text: The library innovation grant award provides exactly $3,200 for evening-pilot overtime and permits that money to be used for two-person coverage; Marcus Lee received the executed award letter from the grants office this week but has not attached it to the proposal.

acceptance_conditions: The pilot must operate Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday rather than Wednesday.
The library must close at midnight on operating nights.
At least two authorized adults must be present after 10:00 p.m.
After 10:00 p.m., entry must be limited to currently enrolled students using college ID cards.
Exactly $3,200 of overtime must be assigned to the pilot from the library innovation grant.
The operating plan must include a formal two-person evening-coverage commitment.

decisive_facts.why: The Wednesday fire-alarm test changes the operating schedule from Monday through Friday to exactly Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.
The after-10:00 p.m. safety rule changes staffing from the proposal's one employee to exactly two authorized adults and requires a two-person coverage commitment.
The access-control limitation changes entry from ordinary student-ID access to currently enrolled students using college ID cards only.
The executed grant award changes the funding decision to exactly $3,200 from the library innovation grant and permits that amount to cover two-person evening staffing.
